items.title: Austin Reaves Scores 43 as Lakers Beat Pistons Without Doncic
items.titleZh: 東契奇缺陣 里夫斯狂砍 43 分助湖人擊敗活塞
items.teaser: 湖人當家球星東契奇沒上場，里夫斯挺身而出攻下 43 分，最後還靠一記「運氣好」的三分球鎖定勝利。
paras: The Los Angeles Lakers beat the Detroit Pistons 121-116 on Sunday in Detroit, even though their star Luka Doncic did not play. Austin Reaves stepped in and scored 43 points. He also made all 11 of his free throws.
洛杉磯湖人週日在底特律以 121 比 116 擊敗活塞，雖然當家球星東契奇（Luka Doncic）沒有上場。里夫斯（Austin Reaves）挺身而出，攻下 43 分，罰球也 11 罰全中。

The Pistons trailed by 26 points in the second quarter, but they fought back. They were down only 109-104 going into the final minute. Then Reaves hit an off-balance 3-pointer just before the shot clock expired, and Detroit's last chance was gone.
活塞在第二節一度落後 26 分，但他們奮力反撲，進入最後一分鐘時只落後 109 比 104。接著里夫斯在進攻時間快結束前，投進一記身體失去平衡的三分球，活塞最後的機會就這樣沒了。

After the game, Reaves joked that the shot was "100% lucky." Walker Kessler added 12 points and 16 rebounds for Los Angeles, which improved to 9-2, the best record in the West. It was the Lakers' fifth win in a row, while Detroit fell to 6-3.
賽後里夫斯開玩笑說，那一球「百分之百是運氣」。凱斯勒（Walker Kessler）替湖人貢獻 12 分、16 個籃板，湖人戰績提升到 9 勝 2 敗，是西區最佳戰績。這是湖人的五連勝，活塞則掉到 6 勝 3 敗。

items.title: TSMC Plays Down Report of a Move into Memory Chips
items.titleZh: 台積電淡化進軍記憶體晶片的報導
items.teaser: 外媒報導台積電應輝達要求研究生產 3D DRAM，台積電回應會專注晶圓代工本業；業界認為短期內跨入記憶體並不容易。
paras: TSMC has played down a report that it might start making memory chips for Nvidia, its largest customer. On November 6, the tech news site The Information reported that TSMC had begun drawing up plans to produce 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request. The report said the timing and the method of securing factories had not been decided.
台積電淡化一則報導，報導說它可能開始替最大客戶輝達生產記憶體晶片。科技新聞網站 The Information 在 11 月 6 日報導，台積電已經應輝達的要求，開始擬定生產 3D DRAM 的計畫。報導也說，生產時程和取得廠房的方式都還沒有決定。

In response, TSMC said it was concentrating on its core foundry business. The company, which holds more than 70% of the global foundry market, said providing technology and manufacturing capacity to the logic chip industry remains its mission.
台積電回應說，公司專注在晶圓代工的核心本業。這家掌握全球超過七成晶圓代工市場的公司表示，為邏輯晶片產業提供技術和製造產能，仍然是它的使命。

Industry officials say a quick move into memory would be difficult, because logic chips and DRAM use different processes and facilities. The memory market has long been led by Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Micron, and all three are currently developing 3D DRAM.
業界人士表示，台積電要在短時間內跨入記憶體並不容易，因為邏輯晶片和 DRAM 使用不同的製程和設備。記憶體市場長期由三星電子、SK 海力士和美光領先，而這三家公司目前也都在開發 3D DRAM。

items.title: Taiwan Closes Its Office in Papua New Guinea as U.S. Voices Concern
items.titleZh: 台灣關閉駐巴紐辦事處 美國表達關切
items.teaser: 巴布亞紐幾內亞以「一個中國」政策為由要求關閉台灣辦事處，外交部決定撤館並全面檢討雙邊關係，美國國務院表示深感關切。
paras: Taiwan has decided to close its office in Papua New Guinea (PNG) after pressure from the PNG government. The Taipei Economic Office in Port Moresby was set up in February 1990, even though the two sides have no official diplomatic ties.
在巴布亞紐幾內亞（巴紐）政府施壓後，台灣決定關閉駐巴紐的辦事處。位於莫士比港的台北經濟辦事處在 1990 年 2 月設立，雖然雙方並沒有正式邦交。

In July, PNG's foreign minister announced that the office must close immediately, citing the country's "one-China" policy. Taiwan protested and stopped buying spot LNG from PNG. After PNG recently repeated its demand, Taiwan's foreign ministry said on Friday that it would withdraw all its staff and fully review the relationship.
7 月時，巴紐外交部長宣布辦事處必須立即關閉，理由是該國遵守「一個中國」政策。台灣提出抗議，並停止向巴紐購買液化天然氣現貨。巴紐最近再次提出要求後，台灣外交部週五表示，將撤回所有駐館人員，並全面檢討雙邊關係。

A U.S. State Department spokesman said Washington was deeply concerned by PNG's decision. He described Taiwan as a reliable and democratic partner and called the closure "yet another example of Beijing's intimidation campaign" against Taiwan.
美國國務院一位發言人表示，美方對巴紐的決定深感關切。他形容台灣是可靠的民主夥伴，並稱這次關閉辦事處是「北京對台灣恐嚇行動的又一個例子」。
words: n. diplomacy · diplomat｜adv. diplomatically｜diplomatic ties 邦交
protests · protested · protesting｜n. protest /ˈproʊtest/ 抗議
不可數｜v. intimidate · intimidated · intimidating｜adj. intimidating

items.title: Gas Leaks Hint That Mars May Still Be Volcanically Active
items.titleZh: 神祕氣體外洩 暗示火星火山可能還「活著」
items.teaser: 歐洲太空總署的軌道器在火星火山裂縫上方，夏天反常地測到大量氯化氫，科學家推測地底可能有休眠的岩漿庫。
paras: A European spacecraft has found signs that Mars may still have volcanic activity. ESA's ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter repeatedly detected unusually high levels of hydrogen chloride in early northern summer above fractures in the Alba Mons volcanic region. Normally, this gas peaks in winter and falls to very low levels in summer.
一艘歐洲太空船發現跡象，顯示火星可能仍有火山活動。歐洲太空總署的「微量氣體軌道器」（ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter）在北半球初夏時，多次在亞巴山（Alba Mons）火山區的裂縫上方，測到含量異常高的氯化氫。這種氣體通常在冬天達到高峰，夏天則降到非常低。

Scientists think ice may seal the cracks during winter, when temperatures reach about -120°C. As the surface warms, the ice disappears and gases from underground can escape. The team suggests that the source could be a dormant magma chamber beneath the volcano.
科學家認為，冬天氣溫降到約零下 120 度時，冰可能把裂縫封住。等到地表變暖，冰消失了，地底的氣體就能跑出來。研究團隊推測，氣體來源可能是火山底下一個休眠中的岩漿庫。

"Our findings suggest that Mars has retained enough internal heat to support volcanic activity until recently," said researcher Daniel Mège. However, the study does not show that Mars is erupting today or that life exists beneath its surface.
研究人員梅吉（Daniel Mège）說：「我們的發現顯示，火星保留了足夠的內部熱量，讓火山活動一直延續到不久之前。」不過，這項研究並沒有證明火星現在正在噴發，也沒有證明地表下有生命存在。
words: seals · sealed · sealing｜n. seal 封條；海豹
a dormant volcano 休火山｜比較 active volcano 活火山｜n. dormancy

analysis.zh: 科學家認為，冬天氣溫降到約零下 120 度時，冰可能把裂縫封住。
parts: ice may seal the cracks during winter,
受詞（名詞子句，省略 that）
關係副詞子句（說明 winter）
analysis.note: think 後面接省略 that 的名詞子句。may seal 用助動詞 may 表示「可能」，是科學家的推測，不是確定的事實。逗號後的 when 子句補充說明 winter 是什麼樣的時候，等於 in winter, temperatures reach …。

analysis.zh: 等到地表變暖，冰消失了，地底的氣體就能跑出來。
analysis.note: as 可以表示「隨著／當…時」，這裡同時有時間和因果的意味。and 連接兩個完整的句子：the ice disappears 和 gases … can escape。from underground 修飾 gases，說明氣體從哪裡來。

quiz.ex: 第一段：repeatedly detected unusually high levels of hydrogen chloride。

quiz.q: Why was the discovery surprising?
opts: The gas was high in early summer, not winter.

It was the first gas ever found on Mars.
quiz.ex: 第一段：Normally, this gas peaks in winter and falls to very low levels in summer，但這次在初夏測到很高的量。

opts: Scientists saw lava flowing on Mars.
The study proves that life exists on Mars.
The source may be a dormant magma chamber.
quiz.ex: 第二段：the source could be a dormant magma chamber beneath the volcano。研究沒有看到噴發、也沒有證明有生命；冬天是零下 120 度。

items.title: Cooper Flagg Scores 43 as Mavericks Rally Past Pacers
items.titleZh: 弗拉格狂砍 43 分 獨行俠逆轉溜馬
items.teaser: 獨行俠半場還落後 10 分，第四節靠弗拉格和厄文聯手反攻，最後以 3 分險勝溜馬，拿下三連勝。
paras: Cooper Flagg scored a season-high 43 points and grabbed 10 rebounds as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Indiana Pacers 125-122 on Monday night in Dallas. Kyrie Irving added 35 points and made seven 3-pointers, also a season high.
弗拉格（Cooper Flagg）週一晚上在達拉斯攻下本季新高的 43 分、抓下 10 個籃板，帶領達拉斯獨行俠以 125 比 122 擊敗印第安納溜馬。厄文（Kyrie Irving）貢獻 35 分，投進 7 記三分球，同樣是本季新高。

Indiana led 66-56 at halftime, and Pascal Siakam had already scored 26 points. However, he added only three more points in the second half, and Dallas outscored Indiana 35-29 in the fourth quarter. Aaron Nesmith added 18 points for the Pacers.
溜馬上半場以 66 比 56 領先，西亞康（Pascal Siakam）上半場就已經拿下 26 分。不過他下半場只再得 3 分，獨行俠則在第四節以 35 比 29 壓過溜馬。溜馬的內史密斯（Aaron Nesmith）也貢獻 18 分。

The ending was tense. P.J. Washington Jr. missed two free throws with four seconds left, but Caleb Martin tipped away Indiana's final pass. Dallas improved to 7-4 and won its third game in a row, while Indiana fell to 3-8.
比賽結尾相當緊張。華盛頓（P.J. Washington Jr.）在剩下 4 秒時兩罰都沒進，但馬丁（Caleb Martin）撥掉了溜馬最後一次進攻的傳球。獨行俠戰績來到 7 勝 4 敗，拿下三連勝；溜馬則掉到 3 勝 8 敗。

items.title: TSMC's October Sales Jump Almost 60% to a Record High
items.titleZh: 台積電 10 月營收年增近六成 創單月新高
items.teaser: AI 晶片需求強勁，台積電 10 月合併營收衝上新台幣 5,868.9 億元，打破 8 月才創下的紀錄，前 10 月累計也成長四成多。
paras: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) said its consolidated sales reached NT$586.89 billion (US$17.81 billion) in October. That was up 59.7 percent from a year earlier and 14.7 percent from September.
台積電表示，10 月合併營收達到新台幣 5,868.9 億元（約 178.1 億美元），比去年同期成長 59.7%，也比 9 月增加 14.7%。

The figure broke the previous monthly record of NT$514.81 billion, which was set in August. In the first ten months of 2026, TSMC's sales rose 43.3 percent to NT$4.49 trillion. Analysts said strong demand for chips made with its advanced 2-nanometer process had boosted shipments.
這個數字打破了 8 月創下的單月紀錄新台幣 5,148.1 億元。今年前 10 個月，台積電營收成長 43.3%，達到新台幣 4.49 兆元。分析師表示，市場對採用先進 2 奈米製程晶片的強勁需求，帶動了出貨量。

TSMC has also raised its growth forecast for the full year to about 44 percent in U.S. dollar terms, up from slightly more than 40 percent in July. The company pointed to robust demand for its advanced manufacturing processes. Its revenue guidance for the fourth quarter is US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion.
台積電也把全年成長預測調高到以美元計約 44%，高於 7 月時預估的略高於 40%。公司指出，市場對其先進製程的需求相當強勁。台積電對第四季的營收預估為 523 億到 543 億美元。

items.title: Taiwan Says It Has No Plans to Rename Its Office in Lithuania
items.titleZh: 外交部：無意更改駐立陶宛代表處名稱
items.teaser: 立陶宛媒體報導立國政府曾要求台灣替代表處改名，台灣外交部重申沒有改名計畫；立陶宛外長則說相關報導不正確。
paras: Taiwan said on Tuesday that it has no plans to change the name of its representative office in Lithuania. The statement came after Lithuania's public broadcaster LRT reported on Monday, citing the news site Delfi, that the Lithuanian government had asked for the change.
台灣週二表示，沒有計畫更改駐立陶宛代表處的名稱。在這之前，立陶宛公共廣播電台 LRT 週一引述新聞網站 Delfi 報導，指立陶宛政府曾要求台灣改名。

According to Delfi, Lithuanian officials gave Taiwan's top envoy an unofficial document in late September. It reportedly said the office's name was obstructing economic ties and causing difficulties for businesses. Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys said the information had been inaccurately reported but declined to comment further.
根據 Delfi 的報導，立陶宛官員在 9 月下旬交給台灣駐立陶宛代表一份非正式文件。文件據稱表示，代表處的名稱阻礙了雙方的經濟關係，也讓企業遇到困難。立陶宛外交部長布德利斯（Kęstutis Budrys）則說，這些資訊的報導並不正確，但拒絕進一步評論。

Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi said the name was chosen to deepen bilateral ties. The Taiwanese Representative Office opened in Vilnius in November 2021. Beijing objected to the word "Taiwanese" in its name and downgraded relations with Lithuania, whose new government has been trying to improve ties with Beijing.
外交部政務次長陳明祺表示，當初選定這個名稱，是為了深化雙邊關係。「駐立陶宛台灣代表處」於 2021 年 11 月在維爾紐斯成立。北京反對名稱裡的「台灣」字樣，並降低了與立陶宛的外交關係；立陶宛的新政府則一直在設法改善與北京的關係。

items.title: A 'Lost' Water Mouse Turns Up in Ethiopia After Almost 100 Years
items.titleZh: 消失近百年 衣索比亞水鼠再度現身
items.teaser: 這種會游泳的老鼠過去只有一件標本，科學家以為牠已經滅絕，沒想到竟在村民洗衣服的小溪裡被找到。
paras: Scientists thought the Ethiopian water mouse was extinct. It was first found in 1927, and for almost a century the only known specimen was that single animal. Its home was believed to have been lost to farming.
科學家原本以為衣索比亞水鼠已經滅絕。牠在 1927 年首次被發現，將近一百年來，已知的標本就只有那一隻。人們認為牠的棲地已經因為農業開發而消失。

Then Mengistu Wale, an ecologist at the Ethiopian Biodiversity Institute, found one in a trap during a survey. He later caught two more in the Yayu Coffee Forest Biosphere Reserve in southwestern Ethiopia. Surprisingly, they lived in a stream where local people wash their clothes.
後來，衣索比亞生物多樣性研究所的生態學家瓦勒（Mengistu Wale）在一次調查中，在陷阱裡發現了一隻。他之後又在衣索比亞西南部的「亞尤咖啡森林生物圈保護區」抓到兩隻。令人意外的是，牠們就住在當地人洗衣服的小溪裡。

"When I saw it for the first time, I was very excited," Wale said. Genetic tests are still being done to confirm the find. Scientists believe the mouse may hunt insects and possibly fish, but they still know very little about how it lives.
瓦勒說：「我第一次看到牠的時候非常興奮。」目前還在進行基因檢測來確認這項發現。科學家認為這種老鼠可能會捕食昆蟲，甚至可能吃魚，但他們對牠的生活方式仍然所知甚少。
words: 複數 traps｜v. trap · trapped · trapping
n. gene · genetics｜genetic test 基因檢測

analysis.zh: 牠在 1927 年首次被發現，將近一百年來，已知的標本就只有那一隻。
analysis.note: was found 是被動語態，first 放在 be 動詞和過去分詞中間，表示「第一次」。for＋一段時間 表示持續多久。後半句是 S＋be＋C 的句型，補語 that single animal 說明主詞是什麼。

parts: the mouse may hunt insects and possibly fish,
受詞（名詞子句，省略 that）
修飾（how 子句當 about 的受詞）
analysis.note: may 表示推測「可能」，possibly 再加強不確定的語氣。know very little about … ＝對…所知甚少，little 表示「幾乎沒有」，帶否定意味；a little 則是「有一些」。how it lives 是名詞子句，語序是「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」。

quiz.ex: 第一段：It was first found in 1927。

opts: In a stream where people wash clothes

opts: Genetic tests have already confirmed the find.

items.title: Lillard Scores 25 as Trail Blazers Beat the Thunder 123-103
items.titleZh: 里拉德攻下 25 分 拓荒者大勝雷霆
items.teaser: 雷霆的四連勝被終結！拓荒者下半場靠里拉德連續三分球拉開比分，以 20 分差大勝，止住兩連敗。
paras: Damian Lillard scored 25 points as the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-103 on Tuesday night in Portland. Deni Avdija added 24 points, eight assists and six rebounds, and Portland snapped a two-game losing streak.
里拉德（Damian Lillard）週二晚上在波特蘭攻下 25 分，帶領波特蘭拓荒者以 123 比 103 擊敗奧克拉荷馬雷霆。阿夫迪亞（Deni Avdija）貢獻 24 分、8 次助攻和 6 個籃板，拓荒者也止住了兩連敗。

The game was close for a long time. It was tied 59-59 at halftime, and Oklahoma City later took a 69-67 lead on a 3-pointer by Jared McCain. Lillard answered with back-to-back 3s, and Portland led 97-80 going into the fourth quarter.
這場比賽有很長一段時間都打得很接近。上半場打成 59 比 59 平手，之後雷霆靠麥肯（Jared McCain）的三分球取得 69 比 67 領先。里拉德隨即連續投進兩記三分球回應，拓荒者帶著 97 比 80 的領先進入第四節。

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led the Thunder with 26 points, but he made only eight of 22 shots and did not play in the fourth quarter. Oklahoma City, which had won four straight games, was missing several injured players, including Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren. The two teams meet again in Portland on Wednesday.
亞歷山大（Shai Gilgeous-Alexander）以 26 分領軍雷霆，但他 22 投只中 8，第四節也沒有上場。原本已經四連勝的雷霆，這場有好幾名球員因傷缺陣，包括傑倫·威廉斯（Jalen Williams）和霍姆格倫（Chet Holmgren）。兩隊週三會在波特蘭再次交手。

複數 streaks｜a winning streak 連勝｜a losing streak 連敗

analysis.note: 用 and 連接兩個完整的句子，前後各有自己的主詞和動詞。三個項目並列時寫成 A, B and C。two-game 是「數字＋名詞」組成的複合形容詞，中間加連字號，名詞要用單數（不是 two-games）。

analysis.note: 逗號夾住的 which 子句是「非限定關係子句」，只是補充說明主詞，拿掉也不影響主要句意。had won 是過去完成式，表示在這場比賽「之前」就已經四連勝。miss 在這裡是「缺少」的意思，was missing players＝少了這些球員。

quiz.ex: 第一段：Damian Lillard scored 25 points。阿夫迪亞是 24 分；麥肯和亞歷山大是雷霆的球員。

items.title: TSMC Plans to Invest in Anthropic and OpenAI
items.titleZh: 台積電董事會通過投資 Anthropic 與 OpenAI
items.teaser: 全球最大晶圓代工廠也要直接持有 AI 公司股份！台積電董事會通過兩筆各最多 5 億美元的投資，並調高每季現金股利。
paras: The board of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) approved plans on Tuesday to invest up to US$500 million in Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI assistant. TSMC will buy the shares at the price set for Anthropic's IPO, which is scheduled for later this month. The board also approved up to US$500 million for preferred shares in OpenAI.
台積電董事會週二通過，將投資最多 5 億美元購買 Anthropic 的股票；Anthropic 是 AI 助理 Claude 的開發商。台積電會以 Anthropic 首次公開發行（IPO）的價格買進股票，這次 IPO 預定本月稍晚進行。董事會也通過最多 5 億美元，用來購買 OpenAI 的特別股。

Market analysts said the two deals show that TSMC is optimistic about AI and wants to own stakes in major AI firms. In addition, the board approved a new investment company with up to US$500 million in capital to invest in semiconductor and related businesses.
市場分析師表示，這兩筆投資顯示台積電看好 AI，也想持有大型 AI 公司的股份。此外，董事會還通過成立一家資本額最多 5 億美元的投資公司，用來投資半導體和相關產業。

TSMC's net profit reached a record NT$763.06 billion in the third quarter, up 68.7 percent from a year earlier. The board also raised the quarterly cash dividend to NT$9 per share from NT$7 and approved a capital budget of about US$40.93 billion to build fabs, add advanced manufacturing capacity and fund research.
台積電第三季淨利創下新台幣 7,630.6 億元的紀錄，比去年同期成長 68.7%。董事會也把每季現金股利從每股新台幣 7 元調高到 9 元，並通過約 409.3 億美元的資本預算，用來蓋晶圓廠、增加先進製程產能和投入研發。

items.title: Acer Founder Stan Shih Named Taiwan's APEC Envoy
items.titleZh: 宏碁創辦人施振榮出任 APEC 特使
items.teaser: 今年 APEC 峰會在中國深圳舉行，總統府派施振榮出席，並希望中方確保台灣平等參與；中國國台辦則說會依「一個中國」原則處理。
paras: Taiwan's Presidential Office said Acer founder Stan Shih will represent President William Lai at this year's APEC leaders' summit, which China is hosting in Shenzhen on Nov. 18-19. Shih also served as Taiwan's envoy to the 2007 APEC summit in Australia. Taiwan has been a full member of APEC since 1991 and takes part under the name "Chinese Taipei."
總統府表示，宏碁創辦人施振榮將代表賴清德總統，出席今年 11 月 18 日至 19 日由中國在深圳主辦的 APEC 領袖會議。施振榮也曾擔任 2007 年澳洲 APEC 峰會的台灣特使。台灣從 1991 年起就是 APEC 的正式成員，以「中華台北」的名稱參與。

Presidential Office spokeswoman Karen Kuo said Shih has extensive experience in international exchanges and understands AI and the digital economy. She said Taiwan hopes China, as the host, will make sure its delegation can attend all meetings with "equality, dignity, and security."
總統府發言人郭雅慧說，施振榮有豐富的國際交流經驗，也了解 AI 和數位經濟。她表示，台灣希望中國以主辦方的身分，確保台灣代表團能在「平等、尊嚴、安全」的條件下出席所有會議。

China's Taiwan Affairs Office said it handles Taiwan's participation according to the "one China" principle and an APEC memorandum of understanding. It said "Chinese Taipei" may attend meetings as long as these practices are followed. Taiwan usually sends business leaders or former officials as its APEC envoys.
中國國台辦則表示，會依照「一個中國」原則和 APEC 的備忘錄來處理台灣的參與。國台辦說，只要遵守這些慣例，「中華台北」就可以出席會議。台灣通常會派企業領袖或卸任官員擔任 APEC 特使。

analysis.note: said 後面的名詞子句省略了 that。Acer founder Stan Shih 是「頭銜＋人名」的寫法，頭銜直接放在名字前面，不加 the。which 子句補充說明這場峰會，which 在子句裡當 hosting 的受詞；is hosting 用現在進行式表示「已經安排好的未來計畫」。

analysis.zh: 國台辦說，只要遵守這些慣例，「中華台北」就可以出席會議。
parts: as long as these practices are followed.
analysis.note: as long as＝「只要」，引導條件子句。are followed 是被動語態（be＋p.p.），意思是「被遵守」。句首的 It 指前一句提到的國台辦（Taiwan Affairs Office），機構用 it 代稱。

quiz.q: Who will represent President Lai at the APEC summit?
quiz.ex: 第一段：Acer founder Stan Shih will represent President William Lai。郭雅慧是總統府發言人。

quiz.q: Where will this year's APEC leaders' summit be held?

items.title: How Hummingbirds Make a Color That Isn't in the Rainbow
items.titleZh: 彩虹裡沒有的顏色 蜂鳥怎麼變出來？
items.teaser: 安氏蜂鳥頭上亮眼的洋紅色羽毛不是靠色素，而是靠羽毛裡奈米級的微小結構反射光線。
paras: Male Anna's hummingbirds have bright magenta feathers on their heads and throats. Magenta is not a color in the rainbow, and the birds do not use a magenta pigment to make it. Instead, the color comes from tiny structures inside the feathers that bend light.
雄性安氏蜂鳥的頭部和喉嚨有鮮豔的洋紅色羽毛。洋紅色不在彩虹的顏色裡，而蜂鳥也不是靠洋紅色的色素來產生它，而是靠羽毛裡能讓光線彎折的微小結構。

Researchers from Yonsei University in South Korea and Ghent University in Belgium used electron microscopes and 3D imaging to study the feathers. They found flattened melanosomes, which hold the pigment melanin, arranged in layers. The structures reflect both red and blue light, and the red peak was nearly three times as strong as the blue one.
來自韓國延世大學和比利時根特大學的研究人員，用電子顯微鏡和 3D 影像研究這些羽毛。他們發現羽毛裡有一層層扁平的黑色素體（裝著黑色素的構造）。這些結構會同時反射紅光和藍光，而紅光的反射峰值將近藍光的三倍強。

When the team used oxygen plasma to remove the top layer, the blue peak weakened and then disappeared. After 60 seconds of treatment, the feathers turned reddish-orange, and after 120 seconds they looked yellowish-orange. The study was published in the Journal of the Royal Society Interface.
研究團隊用氧電漿去掉最上面那一層後，藍光的峰值先變弱、接著完全消失。處理 60 秒後，羽毛變成偏紅的橘色；處理 120 秒後，看起來則是偏黃的橘色。這項研究發表在《英國皇家學會介面期刊》。
words: 複數 pigments｜adj. pigmented 有色素的
複數 structures｜adj. structural｜v. structure 安排、組織
flattens · flattened · flattening｜adj. flat 平的
reflects · reflected · reflecting｜n. reflection 反射；倒影
複數 layers｜v. layer 分層堆疊｜the top layer 最上層

analysis.zh: 而是靠羽毛裡能讓光線彎折的微小結構產生這個顏色。
analysis.note: Instead 放在句首表示「反而、而是」，承接前一句的否定（不是靠色素）。that bend light 是關係子句，修飾 tiny structures，先行詞是複數，所以動詞用 bend 不加 s。come from＝來自。

analysis.zh: 他們發現扁平的黑色素體（裝著黑色素）一層層排列著。
analysis.note: find＋受詞＋過去分詞＝「發現某物處於某種狀態」，arranged in layers 說明受詞的狀態，是受詞補語。中間用逗號夾住的 which 子句補充說明 melanosomes 是什麼。flattened 是過去分詞當形容詞用，意思是「被壓扁的」。

quiz.q: What creates the magenta color of the feathers?
opts: Colors from the flowers they eat
quiz.ex: 第一段：the color comes from tiny structures inside the feathers that bend light，而且文章說蜂鳥 do not use a magenta pigment。

quiz.q: How did the red peak compare with the blue peak?
opts: It was about half as strong.
It was nearly three times as strong.
It was ten times as strong.
quiz.ex: 第二段：the red peak was nearly three times as strong as the blue one。

quiz.q: What did the feathers look like after 120 seconds of treatment?
quiz.ex: 第三段：after 120 seconds they looked yellowish-orange；60 秒時是 reddish-orange。

items.title: Rockets End the Warriors' Eight-Game Winning Streak
items.titleZh: 火箭擊敗勇士 終結對手八連勝
items.teaser: 柯瑞第一節就因傷退場，勇士隊的八連勝在休士頓畫下句點！火箭第四節連拿 8 分拉開差距，以 115 比 108 獲勝。
paras: The Houston Rockets beat the Golden State Warriors 115-108 on Wednesday night in Houston, ending Golden State's eight-game winning streak. It was the Warriors' longest winning streak since 2022. Kevin Durant led Houston with 20 points, while Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each added 19.
休士頓火箭週三晚上在主場以 115 比 108 擊敗金州勇士，終結了勇士的八連勝。這是勇士自 2022 年以來最長的一波連勝。杜蘭特（Kevin Durant）攻下 20 分領軍火箭，申京（Alperen Sengun）和湯普森（Amen Thompson）也各拿 19 分。

Golden State lost Stephen Curry early. He scored three points and left in the first quarter with soreness in his right abdomen, and he did not return. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 25 points and 10 rebounds, and Brandin Podziemski scored 22.
勇士很早就失去了柯瑞（Stephen Curry）。他只拿 3 分，第一節就因右腹部痠痛退場，之後沒有再回到場上。新秀倫德柏格（Yaxel Lendeborg）以 25 分、10 個籃板領軍勇士，波傑姆斯基（Brandin Podziemski）也拿下 22 分。

Houston led by nine early in the fourth quarter, but the Warriors cut the lead to 88-85. The Rockets then scored the next eight points, and back-to-back 3-pointers by Reed Sheppard and Fred VanVleet later made it 102-91. Earlier, Houston's Marcus Smart was ejected late in the third quarter for punching Charles Bassey.
火箭在第四節初領先 9 分，但勇士把差距縮小到 88 比 85。火箭接著連得 8 分，之後薛帕德（Reed Sheppard）和范弗利特（Fred VanVleet）連續投進三分球，把比分拉開到 102 比 91。在這之前，火箭的斯馬特（Marcus Smart）在第三節末段因出拳打到巴西（Charles Bassey）而被驅逐出場。
words: 複數 rookies｜a rookie season 新秀球季
adj. sore 痠痛的｜muscle soreness 肌肉痠痛
cuts · cut · cut · cutting｜cut the lead to 88-85 把領先縮小到 88 比 85
ejects · ejected · ejecting｜n. ejection｜be ejected 被驅逐出場
punches · punched · punching｜n. punch 一拳

analysis.zh: 休士頓火箭週三晚上在主場以 115 比 108 擊敗金州勇士，終結了勇士的八連勝。
parts: 動詞（過去式，與原形同形）
ending Golden State's eight-game winning streak.
analysis.note: 句尾的 ending… 是分詞構句，表示前面那件事「造成的結果」，等於 and it ended…。beat 的三態是 beat · beat · beaten，過去式和原形一樣。eight-game 是複合形容詞，game 要用單數。

analysis.zh: 杜蘭特攻下 20 分領軍火箭，申京和湯普森也各拿 19 分。
parts: while Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each added 19.
analysis.note: while 在這裡不是「當…的時候」，而是用來並列對照兩件事（「而…」）。each 放在動詞前面，表示「兩人各自」都拿了 19 分；19 後面省略了 points，因為前面已經出現過。

quiz.q: Why did Stephen Curry leave the game?
opts: He had soreness in his right abdomen.
He was resting for the next game.
quiz.ex: 第二段：left in the first quarter with soreness in his right abdomen。被驅逐出場的是火箭的斯馬特。

quiz.q: Who led the Warriors in scoring?
quiz.ex: 第二段：Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 25 points。波傑姆斯基 22 分；杜蘭特是火箭的球員。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Warriors had their longest winning streak since 2022.
The Warriors led by nine in the fourth quarter.
Marcus Smart was ejected in the fourth quarter.
The game was played in San Francisco.
quiz.ex: 第一段：It was the Warriors' longest winning streak since 2022。第四節初領先 9 分的是火箭；斯馬特是第三節末段被驅逐；比賽在休士頓。

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Steps In for Now
items.titleZh: 黃仁勳辭去輝達執行長 財務長暫代
items.teaser: AI 晶片巨頭輝達宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長和董事職務，立即生效。由財務長克雷斯暫代執行長，董事會也首度設立董事長。
paras: Nvidia, a chip company valued at more than $4 trillion, announced on Thursday that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately. The board did not give a reason in its announcement. His resignation followed several media reports about his personal relationships.
市值超過 4 兆美元的晶片公司輝達週四宣布，黃仁勳已辭去總裁、執行長和董事職務，立即生效。董事會在聲明中沒有說明原因。他的辭職是在多篇關於他個人感情關係的媒體報導之後發生的。

Chief financial officer Colette Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013, will serve as interim CEO while also keeping her finance job. Harvey Jones, a former CEO of Synopsys, became the company's first-ever board chair. Kress said she was committed to building on the foundation that Huang had created over the last 33 years.
2013 年加入輝達的財務長克雷斯（Colette Kress）將擔任代理執行長，同時繼續兼任財務長。曾任新思科技（Synopsys）執行長的瓊斯（Harvey Jones）則成為公司史上第一位董事長。克雷斯表示，她會在黃仁勳過去 33 年打下的基礎上繼續前進。

Jones said the board had full confidence in Kress and expected operations, customer commitments and product plans to continue without interruption. The board will look for a permanent CEO and will consider both internal and external candidates. Nvidia is scheduled to report its quarterly results on November 17.
瓊斯說，董事會對克雷斯有十足的信心，並預期公司營運、對客戶的承諾和產品規劃都會持續進行、不受影響。董事會將尋找正式的執行長，公司內部和外部的人選都會考慮。輝達預定在 11 月 17 日公布季度財報。
words: resigns · resigned · resigning｜n. resignation 辭職｜resign as CEO 辭去執行長
interim CEO 代理執行長｜in the interim 在這段期間
複數 interruptions｜v. interrupt｜without interruption 不中斷地
adv. permanently｜反義 temporary 暫時的
複數 candidates｜internal candidates 內部人選

analysis.zh: 2013 年加入輝達的財務長克雷斯將擔任代理執行長，同時繼續兼任財務長。
parts: while also keeping her finance job.
analysis.note: 逗號夾住的 who 子句補充說明主詞是誰。serve as… 表示「擔任…」。while keeping… 是 while she also keeps… 的省略：主詞相同時，連接詞後面可以直接接 V-ing，表示「同時」。

analysis.zh: 瓊斯說，董事會對克雷斯有十足的信心，並預期公司營運、對客戶的承諾和產品規劃都會持續進行、不受影響。
parts: the board had full confidence in Kress
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
and expected operations, customer commitments and product plans
名詞子句的第二組動詞＋受詞
analysis.note: said 後面省略了 that。間接引述時時態往前推：has→had、expects→expected。expect + 受詞 + to V 表示「預期某事會…」，三個名詞並列寫成 A, B and C。

Huang's plan to start a new company

opts: Kress will stop working as chief financial officer.
Harvey Jones is the company's first-ever board chair.
The board will only consider people who already work at Nvidia.
Nvidia reported its quarterly results on Thursday.

items.title: Taiwan's Legislature Uses AI to Read Bills Aloud for the First Time
items.titleZh: 立法院首度用 AI 朗讀法案
items.teaser: 立法院委員會首次讓 AI 朗讀 15 個版本的法案，原本要兩個多小時，AI 加速朗讀 70 分鐘就完成。
paras: For the first time, Taiwan's Legislative Yuan used artificial intelligence on Wednesday to read proposed laws aloud. A committee let AI read 15 versions of proposed changes to the Dementia Basic Act.
立法院週三首度使用人工智慧朗讀法案。社會福利及衛生環境委員會讓 AI 朗讀了 15 個版本的《失智症基本法》修正草案。

The AI read at 1.5 times normal speed for the first 10 minutes. After lawmakers said they had no difficulty keeping up, it switched to twice the normal speed. The whole reading took 70 minutes. According to committee chair Chen Ching-hui, a Kuomintang lawmaker, legislative staff would have needed about two hours and 11 minutes.
AI 前 10 分鐘用 1.5 倍速朗讀。立委表示跟得上之後，就改成 2 倍速。整個朗讀花了 70 分鐘。根據委員會召集委員、國民黨立委陳菁徽的說法，如果由議事人員朗讀，大約需要 2 小時 11 分鐘。

Chen said the committee had tested the system with the Legislature's information technology department to make sure it was accurate. The idea came after she lost her voice in 2024 and used an AI version of her voice to question Premier Cho Jung-tai. Chen hopes the first use will pave the way for wider use of AI, and Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu has set up a task force to study possible applications.
陳菁徽說，委員會事先和立法院資訊處一起測試系統，確保內容正確。這個想法來自她 2024 年失聲時，曾用 AI 生成的自己的聲音質詢行政院長卓榮泰。陳菁徽希望這次首度使用能為更廣泛的 AI 應用鋪路；立法院長韓國瑜也已成立專案小組，研究 AI 可能的應用。
words: read aloud 朗讀｜think aloud 邊想邊說出來
複數 proposals｜v. propose 提議｜adj. proposed 被提議的
paves · paved · paving｜pave the way for… 為…鋪路
複數 task forces｜set up a task force 成立專案小組

analysis.zh: 立委表示跟得上之後，就改成 2 倍速。
parts: After lawmakers said they had no difficulty keeping up,
analysis.note: After 引導表示時間的副詞子句，放句首時後面加逗號。have difficulty (in) V-ing 表示「做某事有困難」，所以 had no difficulty keeping up＝跟得上、沒有困難。twice the normal speed 是倍數的寫法：倍數＋the＋名詞。

analysis.zh: 根據委員會召集委員、國民黨立委陳菁徽的說法，如果由議事人員朗讀，大約需要 2 小時 11 分鐘。

items.title: Two Fossil Teeth Reveal a Giant Rodent from 34 Million Years Ago
items.titleZh: 兩顆牙齒化石 揭開 3400 萬年前的巨型齧齒動物
items.teaser: 在泰國礦場找到的兩顆大牙齒，竟屬於一種約 30 公斤重的古老「巨鼠」！牠的名字裡還藏著泰文的「巨人」。
paras: Scientists have identified a previously unknown giant rodent that lived about 34 million years ago in what is now southern Thailand. The species, named Yakamys sirindhornae, is known from only two teeth found at the Krabi lignite mine. The teeth are remarkably large for a rodent.
科學家辨識出一種過去不為人知的巨型齧齒動物，牠大約生活在 3400 萬年前、今天的泰國南部。這個物種被命名為 Yakamys sirindhornae，目前只靠在甲米褐煤礦場找到的兩顆牙齒認識牠。以齧齒動物來說，這兩顆牙齒大得驚人。

Using seven established methods based on tooth size, the team estimated that the animal weighed about 30 kilograms, roughly twice as heavy as other known rodents from the same period. Co-author Virginie Millien of McGill University called this "only a ballpark figure," because estimating body mass from fossils involves a lot of uncertainty.
研究團隊用七種根據牙齒大小推算的既有方法，估計這種動物重約 30 公斤，大約是同時期其他已知齧齒動物的兩倍重。共同作者、麥基爾大學的米連（Virginie Millien）說，這「只是個大概的數字」，因為從化石推估體重有很大的不確定性。

The name Yakamys combines "yak," the Thai word for giant, with "mys," the Greek word for mouse or rat. The researchers say the find suggests that Southeast Asia played an important role in the early evolution of large rodents. Today, the largest living rodent is the capybara. The study was published in Scientific Reports.
Yakamys 這個名字結合了泰文的「yak」（巨人）和希臘文的「mys」（老鼠）。研究人員表示，這項發現顯示東南亞在大型齧齒動物的早期演化中扮演了重要角色。現今體型最大的齧齒動物是水豚。這項研究發表在《科學報告》（Scientific Reports）期刊。
words: 齧齒動物（如老鼠、松鼠、水豚）
adj. remarkable 非凡的｜v. remark 評論
estimates · estimated · estimating｜n. estimate /ˈestɪmət/ 估計值｜n. estimation
複數 uncertainties｜adj. uncertain｜反義 certainty

analysis.zh: 科學家辨識出一種過去不為人知的巨型齧齒動物，牠大約生活在 3400 萬年前、今天的泰國南部。
parts: that lived about 34 million years ago
in what is now southern Thailand.
修飾（地點，含 what 名詞子句）
analysis.note: that lived… 是關係子句，說明是哪一種齧齒動物。in what is now southern Thailand 很常見：what 引導名詞子句，意思是「在現今是泰國南部的地方」，因為 3400 萬年前還沒有「泰國」。previously unknown 是副詞修飾形容詞，「先前未知的」。

analysis.zh: 研究團隊用七種根據牙齒大小推算的既有方法，估計這種動物重約 30 公斤，大約是同時期其他已知齧齒動物的兩倍重。

that the animal weighed about 30 kilograms,
roughly twice as heavy as other known rodents from the same period.
analysis.note: 句首 Using… 是分詞構句，主詞和主要子句相同（the team），表示「用…方法」。倍數比較的句型是：倍數＋as＋形容詞＋as，例如 twice as heavy as＝兩倍重。based on tooth size 是過去分詞片語，修飾 methods。

quiz.ex: 第一段：is known from only two teeth found at the Krabi lignite mine。
